text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I won't let my fans down! I'm... I'm going
to win!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: HYAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No! I am the protagonist of this tale!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: HRAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Unsatisfied and unable to eat, my body
felt
dreary, cold... almost empty)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (But now... there's heat!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I... can still go on.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I can keep running! Farther, harder...
faster!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Faster!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She had always been a solemn

Umamusume—silently bound to realizing
her
self-imposed duty. But now, for the
first time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She burns like a bold and brilliant flame.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega secures a splendid victory
in the
first race of the Classic Triple
Crown! You saw it
here, this spring at
Nakayama! Look at her shine
like a star!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (It's still... hot.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(My throat, my chest... it feels like
they're
burning.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Is this the same heat I felt during my debut race? Is this... your heat?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (It has to be, right? It has to be...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega does an incredible job
winning the
first race of the Classic
Triple Crown in the
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that her appetite seems to be
recovering, I
can assume our
preparations for the Japanese
Derby will
run smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And surprisingly...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: ...Ayabe, we're done with today's routine, you know?
...Ayabe, we're done with today's routine, you know?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oh... yeah. I know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's not enough. I'll never catch up to
Opera O
and Ayabe at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But... the Derby! That's where I'll beat
both of
them!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
How much faster will she get by the time
the Derby
comes around?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Will our next race be even better than—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'm heading back. Thanks for today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little by little...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm seeing her competitive spirit emerge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning for her sister is meaningful in
itself.
choice_data_list: (I'm sure it's a change for the better.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But through running, she's found rivals
and
discovered the joy of competition.
Even better,
she's discovering herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way home one day, my attention
suddenly
turns to the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cloudy days continue as we begin
training for
the Japanese Derby.
choice_data_list: I wonder if she's been able to go stargazing lately.
I wonder if she's been able to go stargazing lately?
